name: Interrogation Chamber
description: This suite includes all of the necessary implements and apparatuses necessary to interrogate, or even torture, a number of prisoners equal to half the ship's suite capacity by size, as shown in the **[Starship Size Suite Capacity](#Starship%20Size%20Suite%20Capacity)** table. When interrogating a prisoner, the interrogator has advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) and Charisma (Persuasion) checks. If they spend at least an hour interrogating a prisoner, the prisoner has disadvantage on Charisma (Deception) checks.
